about_h3_7: Experts in transforming urban balconies into green and relaxing spaces
about_p_13: Urban Balcony was born from a deep love of nature and passion for design. Our story began several years ago when we discovered how difficult it was to find quality, customer-focused solutions for urban balcony gardening. Many city apartment owners dreamed of a private green space but didn't know how to start or which plants would suit the unique conditions of the urban environment.
about_p_14: We decided to create a business that specializes exactly in this - transforming urban balconies and rooftops into green and inviting spaces. We started with a few small projects, and thanks to our commitment to quality, personal service, and impressive results, our reputation grew rapidly. Today, we're proud to be one of the leading providers of urban gardening and landscape design services for balconies in the area.
about_p_15: Our philosophy is simple: every balcony, even the smallest one, can become a green sanctuary that improves quality of life, connects us to nature, and provides a relaxing and inspiring space. We believe that urban gardening is not just about beautiful plants, but also about creating a healthy, sustainable, and inviting environment that reflects each client's personality and style.
about_p_16: We believe every customer is unique and deserves personal and customized service. We listen to needs, understand the vision, and work with complete transparency to create the perfect balcony for you.
about_p_17: We care for the environment and use ecological and sustainable gardening methods. Selecting local plants, water conservation, and using organic fertilizers are an integral part of our work.
about_p_18: Our team consists of experienced experts in gardening, landscape design, and irrigation. We use the highest quality raw materials and insist on perfect execution in every project.
about_p_19: We're always looking for innovative and creative solutions to maximize the potential of every balcony. From smart irrigation technologies to unique designs - we're not afraid to think outside the box.
about_p_20: Urban Balcony's mission is to make the urban environment greener and healthier, one balcony at a time. We believe that urban gardening is not just a trend, but a vital need in the modern world. Our balconies and rooftops are the perfect place to bring nature back into the urban home, improve air quality, and provide a relaxing and inspiring space.
about_p_21: We strive to be the leaders in urban gardening in Israel, and to continue innovating and improving our services to meet the changing needs of our customers. We want every person living in the city to be able to enjoy the urban balcony experience - a private green space that connects us to nature and improves quality of life.
about_p_22: Additionally, we're committed to education and raising awareness about the importance of urban gardening and environmental sustainability. We share our knowledge and experience with customers, organize workshops and study days, and support community projects that promote urban greenery.
about_p_23: The Urban Balcony team consists of experienced experts in gardening, landscape design, irrigation, and maintenance. Each team member brings deep knowledge, years of experience, and genuine passion for the work. We work as a cohesive and committed team, and maintain open and transparent communication with our customers.
about_p_24: Our team includes landscape designers with academic degrees, certified gardeners, professional irrigation technicians, and dedicated service personnel. Each of us brings their unique expertise, and together we create comprehensive and quality solutions that meet the highest standards.
about_p_25: We are proud of our team and their commitment to excellence, personal service, and customer satisfaction. Every project is an opportunity for us to demonstrate our professionalism and dedication, and to create a balcony that will provide years of enjoyment and satisfaction.
about_p_26: We would be happy to help you realize your green balcony vision. Contact us today for free consultation and start the exciting journey of creating your own urban jungle balcony!

services_h2_8: Interested in one of our services?
services_h3_9: Comprehensive solutions for urban balcony design and gardening - from planning to ongoing maintenance
services_p_11: Our comprehensive service begins with a personal consultation meeting where we learn about your needs, preferences, and budget. We conduct a detailed survey of the balcony or rooftop, examining sun exposure conditions, wind directions, and weight and space limitations. We then create a detailed design plan including diagrams, 3D visualizations, and a recommended plant list.
services_p_12: Our planning takes into account all aspects - from selecting resilient plants suitable for urban climate conditions, through furniture arrangement and decorative elements, to installing irrigation and lighting systems. We specialize in creating gardens on small balconies and know how to maximize every centimeter while maintaining a sense of space and airiness.
services_p_13: Our goal is to create an urban jungle balcony that reflects your personality and provides you with a green and relaxing space you can enjoy throughout the year.
services_p_14: Selecting the right plants is critical to project success. We specialize in plants particularly suited to urban conditions - resistant to air pollution, adapting well to varying exposure conditions, and requiring reasonable maintenance. Our variety includes green ornamental plants, seasonal flowers, herbs, and edible plants.
services_p_15: We work with leading suppliers and select high-quality, healthy, and strong plants. Each plant comes with detailed care instructions and recommendations for watering, fertilizing, and pruning. We also offer seasonal plant replacement services to keep your balcony colorful and vibrant throughout the year.
services_p_16: Additionally, we specialize in selecting designed planters and growing containers that complement the design style and ensure optimal growing conditions for the plants.
services_p_17: A proper irrigation system is the key to maintaining your balcony garden. We install advanced automatic irrigation systems specially adapted to the urban environment. Our systems include smart timers that can be programmed according to a precise schedule, moisture sensors that check soil moisture levels, and efficient drip systems that save water.
services_p_18: We offer a variety of solutions - from simple irrigation systems with basic timers, through sophisticated drip systems with multiple separate irrigation zones, to smart systems that can be controlled remotely via smartphone app. Each system is tailored to your specific balcony needs and the types of plants you've chosen.
services_p_19: Installing an automatic irrigation system not only saves you valuable time, but also ensures that plants receive the exact amount of water they need, leading to healthier plants and water conservation.
services_p_20: A balcony garden requires regular maintenance to stay beautiful and healthy. We offer professional maintenance services tailored to your needs - from monthly visits to full weekly service. Our experienced team takes care of all the details: plant pruning and cleaning, regular fertilizing, irrigation system checks, pest and disease treatment, and plant replacement as needed.
services_p_21: We understand that every balcony is unique and requires customized care. Therefore, we create a personal maintenance plan based on your plant types, season, and desired maintenance level. Our team arrives at regular times, equipped with all necessary tools and materials, and performs the work efficiently and professionally.
services_p_22: In addition to ongoing maintenance, we also offer emergency services for urgent problems such as pest outbreaks or plant damage due to severe weather conditions.
services_p_23: We believe in responsible and sustainable gardening. Our services include comprehensive consulting on ecological gardening methods, use of local and resilient plants, water conservation, and use of organic fertilizers and environmentally friendly pest control materials. We teach our clients how to maintain their balcony garden sustainably and contribute to improving air quality and the urban environment.
services_p_24: We also offer innovative solutions such as green walls, balcony composting systems, and organic edible plant cultivation. Our goal is to create balconies that are not only beautiful, but also contribute to the environment and urban quality of life.
services_p_25: For clients seeking a luxury living experience, we offer advanced design services for private rooftops and balconies. Our projects include comprehensive landscape planning, installation of synthetic or natural grass, designed lighting systems, luxurious seating areas, and even water features like small fountains or ornamental pools.
services_p_26: We work with leading designers and use the highest quality materials to create unique and impressive spaces. Each project is carefully planned taking into account structural limitations, building regulations, and safety requirements. The result is a balcony or rooftop that serves as a true extension of the living space and adds significant value to the property.
